bosses.name: Secret Source Automaton: Overseer Device - Obliterator Panoply
Guardian Blade of Drifting Snow: Endless Reverberation

100.desc: After a character uses an Elemental Skill, said character's <color=#F39000>DEF increases by 60%</color> for 9s.

101.desc: After the current active character's Charged Attack hits an opponent, said character's <color=#F39000>ATK increases by 20%</color> for 8s. Max 4 stacks, each stack has an independent duration.

102.desc: All party members' <color=#F39000>Shield Strength is increased by 20%</color>. While the active character is protected by a Shield, when they deal DMG to opponents, their attacks will <color=#F39000>unleash a shockwave</color> at the opponents' position that deals True DMG. This can trigger once every 5s.

103.desc: After a party member triggers a Pyro-related reaction, a <color=#F39000>shockwave</color> will be unleashed at the character's position, dealing True DMG to nearby opponents. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

104.desc: When a character receives healing, a <color=#F39000>shockwave</color> will be unleashed at the character's position, dealing True DMG to nearby opponents. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

105.desc: When a character's Plunging Attacks hit opponents, a <color=#F39000>shockwave</color> will be unleashed at the character's position, dealing True DMG to nearby opponents. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

106.desc: When a character triggers Cryo-related reactions, <color=#F39000>a shockwave will be released</color> at the opponent's position, dealing True DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.

107.desc: When a character's Elemental Skill hits an opponent, it will be counted (1 count can be triggered every 0.9s). When the count reaches 3, a <color=#F39000>shockwave will be unleashed</color> at the hit opponent's location, dealing True DMG and resetting the count.

108.desc: When a character deals Cryo DMG to an opponent, it will be counted. When the count reaches 4, a <color=#F39000>shockwave will be unleashed</color> at the opponent's location, dealing True DMG and resetting the count. 1 such shockwave can be triggered every 4s.

109.desc: When a character triggers Cryo-related reactions, <color=#F39000>a shockwave will be released</color> at the opponent's position, dealing True DMG to nearby opponents. This effect can be triggered once every 2.5s.

110.desc: When a character triggers Hydro-related reactions (including Lunar-Charged), <color=#F39000>a shockwave will be released</color> at the opponent's position, dealing True DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

111.desc: When a character triggers Hydro-related reactions, <color=#F39000>a shockwave will be released</color> at the opponent's position, dealing True DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 2s.

112.desc: When a character triggers Dendro-related reactions, <color=#F39000>a shockwave will be released</color> at the opponent's position, dealing True DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

113.desc: When the active character's Bond of Life value increases or decreases, <color=#F39000>a shockwave will be unleashed</color>, dealing True DMG to nearby opponents.

114.desc: When the active character triggers Swirl on an opponent, a <color=#F39000>shockwave will be unleashed</color> at the opponent's position, dealing True DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 2s.

115.desc: When a character triggers a Lunar reaction (Lunar-Bloom, Lunar-Charged, or Lunar-Crystallize) on an opponent, <color=#F39000>a shockwave will be unleashed</color> at the opponent's position, dealing True DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

116.desc: When a character deals Lunar-Crystallize DMG to an opponent, <color=#F39000>a shockwave will be unleashed</color> at the opponent's position, dealing True DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

117.desc: When a character triggers a Swirl reaction on an opponent, they gain 1 stack of Windlash, and when the stack count reaches 4, <color=#F39000>a shockwave is unleashed</color> at the opponent's position, dealing True DMG and consuming all stacks of Windlash at the same time. Up to 1 stack of Windlash can be gained every 0.1s. A shockwave can be unleashed this way every 6s.

118.desc: When Moondrift Harmony is triggered, <color=#F39000>a shockwave is unleashed</color> at the character's position, dealing True DMG to opponents. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.

119.desc: While the active character is protected by a Shield, when they deal DMG to opponents, their attacks will <color=#F39000>unleash a shockwave</color> at the opponent's position that deals True DMG. This can trigger once every 3s.

120.desc: When an off-field character triggers Cryo-related reactions to opponents, <color=#F39000>a shockwave will be released</color> at the opponent's position, dealing True DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 3.5s.

121.desc: When the active character deals Cryo DMG to opponents with Charged Attacks, their attacks will <color=#F39000>unleash a shockwave</color> at the opponent's position that deals True DMG. This can trigger once every 3s.

122.desc: While the active character is inside a Polestar Field, when they deal DMG to opponents, their attacks will <color=#F39000>unleash a shockwave</color> at the opponent's position that deals True DMG. This can trigger once every 4s.

123.desc: When a character deals Swirl or Stellar Swirl DMG to an opponent, <color=#F39000>a shockwave will be unleashed</color> at the opponent's position, dealing True DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.

124.desc: When a character triggers a Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Cryo Swirl, Stellar Swirl, Frozen, or Shatter reaction on an opponent, or deals Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG to an opponent, <color=#F39000>a shockwave will be unleashed</color> at the opponent's position, dealing True DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 2s.

99.desc: After the active character uses an Elemental Skill, <color=#F39000>Normal Attack and Elemental Skill DMG is increased by 40%</color> for 12s. For characters in <color=#F39000>Nightsoul's Blessing</color>, this effect is enhanced: <color=#F39000>Normal Attack and Elemental Skill DMG is increased by 80%</color>.

leyline.name: Cascading Moon
leyline.desc: When a character deals Swirl or Stellar Swirl DMG to an opponent, <color=#F39000>a shockwave will be unleashed</color> at the opponent's position, dealing True DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.

12.first_half_buff: Characters' Swirl DMG increased by 200% and Stellar Swirl DMG increased by 75%.
12.second_half_buff: Characters' Electro-Charged DMG increased by 200% and Lunar-Charged DMG increased by 75%.

difficulty_config.name: Dire
desc_list: <color=#FF5E41>A powerful opponent has re-emerged from the Ley Lines, and the battle is sure to be very difficult</color>
Affected by the Ley Line Disturbance, <color=#FFD780FF>characters cannot be deployed multiple times</color>

You have reached the final defensive line of the Domain. The level of disturbance here is at its highest, interfering with even the Exalted Ones and rendering their Eminent Boons ineffective. After completing the current challenge in Single-Player Mode, characters in your party will be granted Eminence or Enduring Eminence based on your performance.
During the Disturbance Outbreak, you can complete battles to claim special rewards

1012061.name: Battle-Hardened Domovoy Sculptor: Gale Hewing
1012061.desc: An ice sculptor with a body honed through countless trials, capable of shaping Prime Ice by wielding Anemo energy as hammer and chisel.\nTwisted by Ley Line currents even more appalling than his own artistic taste, the sculptor has succumbed to a frenzy of irrepressible inspiration. He now seeks to carve flesh and bone with howling gales and seal souls within unbreakable Prime Ice, eager to turn every intruder before him into the latest masterpiece in this exhibition of calamity.
monster_buff_desc_list: When battle begins, the Nemesis will attempt to create a Prime Ice sculpture. Once completed, it will transform into a Big-Mouthed Jack Frost that continuously launches snowballs.\nInflict <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color> on the Nemesis while it is creating the sculpture to turn the ice sculpture into a harmless animal statue instead.

Due to the effects of the Ley Line disturbance, the Nemesis will <color=#FFD780FF>start the battle with greatly increased All Elemental RES and Physical RES</color> and will create Prime Ice sculptures more frequently.\nAfter an ice sculpture is transformed into a small animal statue, it will explode following a brief delay, dealing damage to the Nemesis and <color=#FFD780FF>reducing its All Elemental RES and Physical RES, while further reducing its Anemo RES</color>. This effect can <color=#FFD780FF>stack up to 3 times</color>.
monster_buff_detail_list: When battle begins, the Nemesis will harness Anemo energy to create a Prime Ice sculpture. After a short delay, the sculpture will transform into a Big-Mouthed Jack Frost that continuously launches snowballs.\nInflict <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color> on the Nemesis while it is creating the sculpture to interrupt the process and turn the ice sculpture into a harmless animal statue instead.

Due to the effects of the Ley Line disturbance, the Nemesis will <color=#FFD780FF>start the battle with greatly increased All Elemental RES and Physical RES</color> and will create Prime Ice sculptures more frequently.\nAfter an ice sculpture is transformed into a small animal statue, it will explode following a brief delay, dealing damage to the Nemesis and <color=#FFD780FF>reducing its All Elemental RES and Physical RES, while further reducing its Anemo RES</color>. This effect can <color=#FFD780FF>stack up to 3 times</color>.

1001063.name: Secret Source Automaton: Overseer Device - Obliterator Panoply
1001063.desc: A domination mechanism from the ancient ruins.\nIn the distant past, a once-mighty ancient race used this mechanism to oversee the operation of their cities. Even now, long after the fall of their civilization, it still retains immense authority.\nIn the depths of the chaotic Ley Lines, the core energy module that deteriorated over the lengthening years has been restored, indeed, even "overclocked" to a dangerous degree. This machine is now unchained by its original specifications, capable of freeing itself from the planet's shackles and using its horrific "Obliterator Panoply"...
monster_buff_desc_list: Will immediately enter Sweeper Mode when combat starts: <color=#FFD780FF>All RES is greatly increased</color>, and it will perform rotating attacks while generating Flow Momentum. It will lose Flow Momentum after taking <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. Below a certain Flow Momentum value, it will temporarily stop rotating and attacking, and its <color=#FFD780FF>All RES will be greatly decreased</color>.

If an active character enters and maintains the <color=#FFD780FF>Nightsoul's Blessing</color> state for a time, this opponent will enter Forced Counterstrike Mode and switch to attacking with powerful tracking rays. At this time, its <color=#FFD780FF>All RES will be greatly decreased</color>.

Affected by the Ley Line disturbance, this great foe has its All RES further increased, and it loses less Flow Momentum when struck by <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. When in Counterstrike Mode, it will launch even more powerful tracking ray attacks, and it will lose less RES.
monster_buff_detail_list: Will immediately enter Sweeper Mode when combat starts: <color=#FFD780FF>All Elemental and Physical RES is greatly increased</color>, and it will generate Flow Momentum while performing attacks. The higher its Flow Momentum, the faster it will rotate and the more DMG it will deal.\nIt will lose Flow Momentum after taking <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. Below a certain Flow Momentum value, it will stop rotating and attacking, and its <color=#FFD780FF>All Elemental and Physical RES will be greatly decreased</color>, with its <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo RES</color> <color=#FFD780FF>decreasing still more</color>.\nEach time it enters Sweeper Mode, it will produce additional Elemental Orbs the first time its rotating attacks are stopped.

If an active character enters and maintains the <color=#FFD780FF>Nightsoul's Blessing</color> state for a time, this opponent will enter Forced Counterstrike Mode and switch to attacking with powerful tracking rays. At this time, its <color=#FFD780FF>All Elemental and Physical RES will be decreased</color>.\nIn this state, after it takes a certain number of <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> instances, it will cease attacking altogether and its <color=#FFD780FF> All Elemental and Physical RES will be further decreased</color>.

Affected by the Ley Line disturbance, this great foe has its All RES further increased, and it loses less Flow Momentum when struck by <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. It will also lose less RES when in Forced Counterstrike Mode.

1012063.name: Guardian Blade of Drifting Snow: Endless Reverberation
1012063.desc: An ancient Snegovik held in high esteem by her clan, she was once entrusted with the lifelong duty of protecting her people.\nWarped by the turbulent flood within the Ley Lines, the hollow delusion she once called "protection" has been stripped down to a pure instinct for slaughter. Concealed within the shadow of the Ice Coffin, she lies in wait, ready at any moment to become an elusive, razor-sharp blade of ice and tear apart any living thing that ventures near.
monster_buff_desc_list: When its HP falls below a certain threshold, the Nemesis will create a <color=#FFD780FF>Cryo Ward</color> to protect itself.\nWhile the ward is active, the Nemesis will attack with icy storms. If the ward is not destroyed, the Nemesis restores a portion of its HP. If the ward is destroyed, the Nemesis takes backlash DMG. Due to the Ley Line disturbance, its <color=#FFD780FF>Cryo Ward will be more durable</color>. A short time after the ward is broken for the first time, the Nemesis will <color=#FFD780FF>create another Cryo Ward</color>.

While the <color=#FFD780FF>Cryo Ward is active</color>, if the Nemesis is affected by <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>, <color=#FFD780FF>the Cryo Ward will transform into a shield that absorbs DMG.</color> Once the shield is destroyed, the Nemesis will take a large amount of backlash DMG.
monster_buff_detail_list: During battle, when the Nemesis's HP falls below a certain threshold, it will encase itself in an Ice Coffin and gain a <color=#FFD780FF>Cryo Ward</color> to protect itself.\nWhile the Ice Coffin is active, the Nemesis will continuously unleash icy storms around itself. If the Ice Coffin is not destroyed, the Nemesis restores a portion of its HP and creates ice swords to launch a counterattack. However, if the Ice Coffin sustaining its life is destroyed, it enters a weakened state for a period of time and takes backlash DMG. Due to the Ley Line disturbance, <color=#FFD780FF>the Ice Coffin will be more durable</color>. A short time after it is destroyed for the first time, the Nemesis will <color=#FFD780FF>encase itself in another Ice Coffin</color>.

While the <color=#FFD780FF>Ice Coffin is active</color>, if the Nemesis is affected by <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>, <color=#FFD780FF>the Ice Coffin's Cryo Ward will transform into a shield that absorbs DMG</color>. Once the shield is destroyed, the Nemesis will take a large amount of backlash DMG.
